name: IVR
tagline: International Representation for Inland Waterway Transport
hero_kpi_rationale: Indicateur pertinent du rôle fédérateur de l'association dans le secteur maritime fluvial européen. Le congrès 2024 a rassemblé 225 participants de 11 pays, reflétant l'engagement des parties prenantes et la légitimité de la représentation sectorielle.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the annual IVR Congress, reflecting sector engagement and association reach.
kpis.description: IVR Congress 2024 held in Frankfurt am Main (May 15-17) with 225 participants from 11 countries

kpis.name_fr: Participants au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, representing insurance and maritime professionals.
kpis.description: First Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp (November 4, 2024) with 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with active IVR membership and representation.
kpis.description: IVR represents inland waterway transport interests across 11 European countries

kpis.explanation: Number of new technical guidance documents issued by IVR committees to the industry.
kpis.description: IVR committees issued multiple new technical documents in 2024 to support industry standards

kpis.explanation: Active observer participation in European Committee for Standardization in Inland Navigation working groups.
kpis.signal: Regulatory influence in technical standards development
kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in CESNI working group meetings (April 11, October 17, 2024) contributing to harmonization of European inland navigation standards

kpis.explanation: Representatives from shipping industry, insurance, and vessel survey sectors on the Board of Management.
kpis.description: Board composed of national representatives from shipping, insurance, and ship survey sectors across member countries

ai_positioning.summary: No references to artificial intelligence, generative AI, or advanced automation tools in the 2024 annual report. IVR's focus remains on traditional sectoral representation, regulatory participation, and knowledge exchange.
evidence: No mention of AI, machine learning, or automation technologies
Focus on technical standardization (CESNI), regulatory representation, and loss prevention
References to digitalization in inland shipping context but not to AI implementation
Emphasis on traditional activities: workshops, congresses, committee participation
